title: A protocol to investigate the effects of lncRNAs on in vivo protein-protein interactions using proximity ligation assay
protocol: Place the 14 mm round glass coverslips into a 24-well plate.
Seed cells onto the coverslips in the 24-well plate.
Let cells stand for 15 min for adhesion.
Incubate cells at 37°C in the CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Transfect 10 pmol siRNA for p53 into LINC00324 knockdown and overexpression U2OS cells using Lipofectamine RNAiMAX transfection reagent according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Add 10 pmol si-p53 to 50 μL Opti-MEM medium.
Add 1.5 μL Lipofectamine RNAiMAX reagent to 50 μL Opti-MEM medium.
Combine both solutions and incubate for 10–20 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Add the complexes to each well containing cells.
Mix gently by rocking the plate back and forth.
Incubate the cells at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
After 48 h growing, subject the cells to fixation.
Remove medium from cells and wash with 1× PBS for 5 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Fix cells with 4% PFA for 20 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Wash cells with 1× PBS 3 times, each for 5 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Permeabilize cells with 1× PBS containing 0.3% Triton X-100 for 20 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Wash cells with 1× PBS 3 times, each for 5 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Draw a hydrophobic circle along the coverslips’ edges using a PAP pen.
Add 60 μL of Duolink Blocking Solution to each sample.
Incubate slides in a humidity chamber for 1 hour at 37°C.
Dilute primary antibody to a suitable concentration in custom antibody diluent.
Aspirate off the blocking solution from coverslips as much as possible.
Add 60 μL of the diluted primary antibodies solution to each sample on the coverslips.
Incubate slides in a humidity chamber for 12–18 h at 4°C.
Remove primary antibody solution and wash slides with 50 mL 1× Wash Buffer A twice for 5 min each on a shaker at room temperature (22°C-26°C).
Aspirate excess wash buffer from the slides.
Dilute two 5× Duolink PLA probe at 1:5 in Duolink Antibody Diluent and mix Anti-Mouse PLUS and Anti-Rabbit MINUS PLA probes.
Add 60 μL of the PLA probe mixture solution to each sample on the coverslips.
Incubate slides in a pre-heated humidity chamber for 1 h at 37°C.
Remove PLA probe solution from slides.
Wash the slides with 50 mL 1× Wash Buffer A for 5 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Repeat slide washing step with another 50 mL 1× Wash Buffer A for an additional 5 min at room temperature.
Dilute 5× Duolink Ligation buffer in a 1:5 ratio with Milli-Q water.
Gently pipette to dissolve any precipitated DTT in the diluted ligation buffer.
Add ligase to the diluted ligation buffer in a 1:40 ratio and mix immediately before use.
Remove excess wash buffer from slides.
Add 60 μL of Ligase-Ligation solution to each sample on the slide.
Incubate the slides in a humidity chamber for 30 min at 37°C.
Dilute 5× Amplification Far Red buffer in a 1:5 ratio with Milli-Q water, protecting from light.
Add Polymerase to diluted amplification buffer in a 1:80 ratio and mix immediately before use.
Remove excess wash buffer from slides after ligation step.
Add 60 μL of Polymerase-Amplification solution to each sample on the slide.
Incubate the slides in a humidity chamber for 100 min at 37°C.
Remove the Polymerase-Amplification solution from slides.
Wash the slides twice for 10 min each in 50 mL of 1× Wash Buffer B at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Wash the slides with 50 mL of 0.01× Wash Buffer B for 1 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Air dry the excess wash buffer.
Drop 5 μL DAPI Fluoromount G on a microscope glass slide.
Place coverslips upside down on the slide carefully to spread the mounting solution evenly.
Dry the slides in the dark for 15 min at room temperature (22°C–26°C).
Seal all sides of coverslips with clear nail polish or neutral balsam for long-time storage.
Acquire images using a confocal microscope with at least a 20× objective.
